entities.summary: The Skalnaté pleso Observatory is an astronomical and meteorological observatory located in the locality of the same name in the High Tatra Mountains in Slovakia, at coordinates 49°11′21.77″N 20°14′1.49″E and at an altitude of 1,786 metres (5,860 ft) on the south-eastern slopes of Lomnický štít near Tatranská Lomnica.
